description: This Java class `FundTransferService` provides services related to fund transfers, including initiating a transfer and reading transfer records. It interacts with a repository for persistence, uses a mapper for DTO conversions, and calls an external REST client for actual fund transfer operations.

classes.name: FundTransferService
classes.description: Service class managing fund transfer operations, integrating repository, mapper, and REST client.

methods.name: fundTransfer
methods.description: Performs a fund transfer request, updates transfer status, and returns the response.

methods.name: readAllTransfers
methods.description: Retrieves all transfer records with pagination, converting entities to DTOs.
